name: Spline Parameterization
definition: An improvement over piecewise linear parameterization using cubic Hermite spline formulation (Catmull-Rom) to approximate the curve ρ(f(t)).
summary: Spline parameterization approximates transfer functions using cubic Hermite splines to provide smoother adherence with fewer samples, distinguishing itself from linear chord parameterization by estimating tangents for curved interpolation.
